answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The copper holds work receipts rather than names, so the pigment of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
